description: Frozen point estimates before Week 3 Monday Night Football. The week map includes full-game injury absences in Weeks 1–3, including confirmed upcoming Week 3 inactives, plus estimated future missed regular-season games. Partial-game exits do not count as a whole missed game. Byes, healthy scratches and unsigned free-agent weeks are excluded. Each return week is a single modeling estimate unless the source explicitly confirms it; no uncertainty ranges are output. A null return week means no scheduled-game return is projected; the player rationale distinguishes season-ending injury from no current team. Historical years use only NFLQuery box scores, not these current-news judgments.

completedGamesSource.method: Existing NFLQuery fetchCompletedGameIds and fetchSummaryGame ingestion of completed ESPN games; team reports resolve injury cause and active players without box-score statistics.

Josh Jacobs.reason: Commissioner exempt list, not an injury. No injury weeks assigned.

sources.title: Packers keep six receivers, seven defensive linemen: Here is the initial 2026 roster
sources.fact: Team lists Jacobs on the commissioner exempt list.

Justin Jefferson.rationale: Point estimate: no additional full-game absence. O'Connell said Jefferson nearly returned during Week 3, supporting Week 4 rather than assigning an absence solely for questionable status. Played Weeks 1, 2 and 3. Ankle evaluation still pending.

sources.title: Justin Jefferson Injury: Nearly came back in after hurting ankle
sources.fact: O'Connell said Jefferson was close to returning more than once Sunday; further ankle evaluation was planned.

Baker Mayfield.rationale: Point estimate: miss Weeks 4 and 5, return Week 6. This is a throwing-thumb dislocation, with MRI pending and no fracture on X-ray. The second upcoming game falls Thursday, just 11 days after injury, so a Week 6 estimate is more defensible than a generic two-game penalty. No confirmed return timetable. Played all three initial games.

sources.title: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield suffered dislocated right thumb in loss to Vikings
sources.fact: Bowles confirmed a dislocated right thumb late in Week 3; X-rays showed no fracture and Monday MRI was planned.

sources.title: Buccaneers 2026 schedule release hub
sources.fact: Tampa Bay plays Week 4 October 4, Week 5 Thursday October 8, and Week 6 October 18; bye Week 10. Accessed September 28, 2026.

Mike Evans.rationale: Point estimate: miss Week 4 and return Week 5. Rapoport reported a rib strain, while Shanahan said rib versus oblique injury remained unresolved. Assume a short absence rather than a confirmed fracture or lengthy absence; confidence is low until Monday testing. Played Weeks 1–3, including his Week 2 hip issue and Week 3 exit.

sources.title: Report: 49ers WR Mike Evans has rib strain, will be evaluated Monday
sources.fact: Rapoport reported rib strain; Shanahan said the team could not yet distinguish broken rib from oblique injury. Further tests Monday.

sources.title: Mike Evans makes his three catches count before early Week 3 exit
sources.fact: USA TODAY fantasy analysis expects a Week 4 absence while imaging is pending; this is analysis rather than a team ruling.

Puka Nacua.rationale: Point estimate: return Week 4, aligning with McVay's expectation barring setbacks. Missed Weeks 2 and 3 for hip/groin symptoms after playing Week 1. Surgery remains a contingency if improvement fails, not the expected course.

sources.title: Rams Puka Nacua doubtful to play Sunday night vs. Broncos
sources.fact: McVay expected Week 4 availability barring a setback; second straight missed game anticipated.

sources.title: Rams Injury Update: Puka Nacua Inactive In Week 3 Vs. Broncos
sources.fact: Nacua inactive Week 3 after missing Week 2. Schefter reported predominantly groin symptoms and possible surgery if persistent.

Travis Etienne Jr.rationale: Point estimate: return Week 6 after missing Weeks 4 and 5. He was already managing a hamstring issue before being cleared for Week 3, then left that game with hamstring symptoms. The recurrence supports more caution than a brand-new minor concern. No reported grade or medical timetable; estimate remains provisional. Played Weeks 1–3.

sources.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) good to go for Sunday
sources.fact: Etienne was cleared for Week 3 after managing a hamstring injury that week.

sources.title: Saints RB Travis Etienne leaves loss to Raiders early with apparent hamstring injury
sources.fact: Etienne left in the third quarter after reaching for his left hamstring; further details were unknown.

Jalen Coker.injury: New quadriceps injury; preceding ankle injury
Jalen Coker.rationale: Point estimate: no future missed game, return Week 4. His postgame assessment that the new quad injury was not serious weighs against automatically holding him through the Week 5 bye. Imaging and practice response remain pending. Played all three initial games despite preceding ankle concern.

sources.title: Panthers Jalen Coker: Not concerned about injury
sources.fact: RotoWire, citing Joe Person: Coker did not believe the quad injury serious after exiting Week 3; imaging and Wednesday practice would clarify availability.

De'Von Achane.rationale: Low-confidence point estimate: prolonged absence with a Week 10 return, missing Weeks 4, 5, 7, 8 and 9. Week 6 is the bye. This seven-week recovery allowance is an explicit modeling assumption, not a reported timetable or diagnosis. Current reporting supports concern about severity but does not establish a torn ligament or season-ending injury; MRI could materially change this frozen estimate. Played Weeks 1–3.

sources.title: What happened to De’Von Achane? Live injury updates for Dolphins vs. Chiefs
sources.fact: Achane exited early with a knee injury. Hafley was pessimistic postgame but supplied no diagnosis.

sources.title: Dolphins not optimistic about De’Von Achane’s knee injury
sources.fact: Monday MRI was planned; no definitive diagnosis was reported.

Jalen McMillan.rationale: Point estimate: miss Weeks 4 and 5, return Week 6. Knee trouble caused a Week 1 absence; he was ACTIVE for Week 2 despite no box-score production and played before reinjury in Week 3. Recurrence plus the Thursday Week 5 game supports a recovery break through Week 5. Monday MRI pending, no confirmed timetable.

sources.title: Browns-Bucs Inactives | Jacob Parrish Ruled Out
sources.fact: Team confirmed McMillan active Week 2 after missing Week 1 with the training-camp knee injury.

sources.title: Buccaneers | Jalen McMillan to undergo MRI on left knee Monday
sources.fact: Monday left-knee MRI planned to determine injury extent.

sources.title: Jalen McMillan Injury: Questionable to return Sunday
sources.fact: McMillan twisted the left knee in the first quarter and was removed.

sources.title: Buccaneers 2026 schedule release hub
sources.fact: Tampa Bay plays Week 4 October 4, Week 5 Thursday October 8, and Week 6 October 18; bye Week 10. Accessed September 28, 2026.

Breece Hall.rationale: Point estimate: one full-game absence, Week 5 return. Left Week 3 late with thigh symptoms and planned MRI; neither a grade nor longer timetable was established. Do not treat game exit as a Week 3 absence. Played Weeks 1–3.

sources.title: Jets RB Breece Hall out with thigh injury, headed for MRI
sources.fact: Hall injured his thigh in the fourth quarter and was ruled out for the game; Monday MRI expected.

Devin Singletary.rationale: No injury absence in Weeks 1–3 or projected thereafter. Week 3 was a healthy scratch, so Week 4 is only the first future modeled week and is not a prediction of game-day selection.

sources.title: Devin Singletary officially inactive for Week 3
sources.fact: Week 3 inactive was a healthy scratch after playing the first two games.

sources.title: NFL Week 3 Inactives: Who’s in, who’s out for Giants vs. Titans
sources.fact: Team lists Singletary inactive and identifies other injured/questionable players, with no Singletary injury.

Adonai Mitchell.rationale: Point estimate: return Week 4 after one full missed game. Finger injured in Thursday practice; limited Friday and game-time decision Sunday suggest a near-term return, with no multiweek prognosis. Played Weeks 1–2.

sources.title: Jets Adonai Mitchell inactive vs. Lions in latest hit to wide receiver group
sources.fact: Injured finger Thursday, practiced limited Friday with wrapped hand, inactive Sunday.

sources.title: Adonai Mitchell INACTIVE
sources.fact: Mitchell was a Week 3 game-time decision per Jeremy Fowler before being declared inactive.

Jonah Coleman.rationale: Point estimate: return Week 7 at the minimum IR eligibility, supported by current reporting expecting late-October return against Arizona. Week 2 was played through injury, so count Week 3 onward only.

sources.title: Broncos rookie RB Jonah Coleman heading to IR with ankle injury
sources.fact: IR begins with Week 3, requiring four missed games; Week 7 earliest eligibility. Injury sustained during Week 2, which he finished.

sources.title: Broncos | Jonah Coleman (high-ankle sprain) headed to IR, expected back in late October
sources.fact: Report expects return against Arizona in late October after high-ankle sprain.

Dallas Goedert.rationale: Point estimate: miss Weeks 3, 4 and 5, return Week 6. Translate the reported few-week MCL absence into three missed games; no IR placement or exact clearance date reported. Week 2 game exit is not counted. Week 3 Monday game remains unplayed at cutoff, but he is already ruled out.

sources.title: Source: Eagles tight end Dallas Goedert will miss time with a knee injury
sources.fact: MCL sprain during Week 2; expected to miss a few weeks.

sources.title: Dallas Goedert Injury: Won’t play Monday
sources.fact: Ruled out for Week 3 after no practices; considered week-to-week.

Caleb Williams.rationale: Point estimate: miss Weeks 3, 4 and 5 and return Week 6, four weeks after the Week 2 injury. This maps the reported Grade 2 recovery expectation to one date; a quicker recovery remains possible. Week 3 Monday game unplayed at cutoff but Williams has been ruled out.

sources.title: Sources: Caleb Williams injury considered to have 3-4 week timeline
sources.fact: Schefter and Rapoport report Grade 2 hamstring injury and typical three-to-four-week recovery; faster return possible. Williams ruled out Week 3.

Caleb Williams.observedAbsenceNote: Week 3 is a confirmed ruled-out absence for an upcoming Monday game, not a completed-game observation.

Alec Pierce.rationale: Point estimate: Week 8 return, missing five full games Weeks 3–7. Fowler reported a hoped-for four-to-six-week recovery, with potential to take longer. Week 8 is six weeks after Week 2 heel aggravation, beyond the Week 7 IR minimum; no return is confirmed.

sources.title: Alec Pierce Injury: Officially goes on injured reserve
sources.fact: Placed on IR after aggravating the heel in Week 2; X-rays negative.

sources.title: Fantasy Football Injury Impact: Alec Pierce Being Placed On IR Could Make Josh Downs A Breakout Star
sources.fact: Quotes Fowler: team hopes four to six weeks, possibly longer; attempting rehab rather than further surgery.

Rico Dowdle.rationale: Point estimate: miss Week 4 Thursday as well as confirmed Week 3, then return Week 5. Toe injury required a boot and an entire week without practice; a four-day turnaround makes another absence more plausible than instant return. No official timetable. Played Weeks 1–2.

sources.title: Rico Dowdle Injury: Sitting out practice, sporting boot on foot
sources.fact: Toe injury led to a right-foot boot after Week 2 exit.

sources.title: Rico Dowdle’s Status vs. Bengals Signals Shift in Steelers Backfield
sources.fact: Did not practice Wednesday through Friday and ruled out Week 3.

Nico Collins.rationale: Point estimate: Week 4 return, with no additional missed games beyond Weeks 2 and 3. Latest reporting says progress on a Grade 1 hamstring injury and positive Week 4 outlook subject to increased activity. This is not clearance.

sources.title: Texans | Nico Collins making progress, status for Cowboys game positive
sources.fact: Progressing from Grade 1 hamstring injury; second consecutive missed game; Week 4 outlook positive pending activity increase and no setbacks.

Caleb Douglas.rationale: Played Weeks 1 and 2, then missed Week 3 with the right ankle injury from late Week 2. A full week without practice supports allowing one further missed game, then a Week 5 return approximately three weeks after injury. This is a low-confidence modeling estimate; no injury grade, IR placement, or reported return date establishes an exact duration.

sources.title: Dolphins standout WR Caleb Douglas out for Sunday’s game vs. Chiefs
sources.fact: Hafley ruled Douglas out for Week 3; injured ankle late in Week 2 and did not practice Wednesday or Thursday.

sources.title: Caleb Douglas dealing with ankle injury
sources.fact: Coach said it was too early to establish his ankle outlook.

Tyreek Hill.rationale: Unsigned free agent; no team schedule exists to assign injury-missed games, so both absence lists are empty. Current reporting supports ongoing knee rehabilitation and possible October medical readiness, not a confirmed team or football return. Week 6 is only a separate modeling estimate of medical readiness; a null estimatedReturnWeek here means no scheduled-game return can be projected.

sources.title: Doctors recommend Tyreek Hill hold off on coming back until October
sources.fact: Agent: doctors advised postponing comeback until October; still unsigned.

Jaxson Dart.injury: Left knee meniscus, MCL and PCL injuries
Jaxson Dart.rationale: Played Weeks 1 and 2. Week 2 knee injury required meniscus surgery; Harbaugh confirmed no regular-season return. Week 3 and every remaining scheduled regular-season game are missed. A possible postseason return does not alter this model.

sources.title: Giants QB Jaxson Dart to undergo season-ending knee surgery
sources.fact: Head coach confirmed season-ending surgery after Week 2 injury; meniscus, MCL and PCL damage, ACL intact; repair recovery four to six months.

Jayden Reed.rationale: Played Weeks 1 and 2, missed Week 3. There is no published diagnosis-specific recovery duration or confirmed season-ending decision. Week 12 is retained solely as a high-uncertainty scenario estimate for an extended absence through the Week 11 bye, not a medically established return or evidence that this exact week is most likely. Season-ending absence cannot be inferred from the coach saying it is too early to know.

sources.title: Packers rule out four, list two questionable vs. Falcons | Week 3 Injury Report
sources.fact: Reed ruled out for Week 3 with neck injury.

sources.title: Matt LaFleur provides update on WR Jayden Reed: He’s doing OK
sources.fact: Back in Green Bay undergoing testing and consultations; LaFleur did not know whether he would play again in 2026.

Jayden Daniels.rationale: Played Weeks 1 and 2, then missed Week 3. The team explicitly declined IR after specialist reviews, calls him week-to-week and currently plans no surgery. Week 6 is a cautious single estimate within the under-four-game absence implied by that decision: miss Weeks 3, 4 and 5, then return about four weeks after the September 20 injury. It is not an official clearance or a guarantee he returns before the Week 7 bye.

sources.title: Jayden Daniels considered week-to-week, will not be placed on IR
sources.fact: Quinn said Daniels will not go on IR after Week 2 elbow dislocation; surgery not currently considered; Week 3 Mariota start confirmed and official return timetable absent.

Jonathon Brooks.rationale: Played Weeks 1 and 2 before aggravating a groin/core injury. IR began September 23, with surgery reported September 23 or planned September 24. The coach supplied six to eight calendar weeks; choosing seven weeks and the next game yields Week 10, November 15. This is later than Week 8 minimum IR eligibility: the four missed team games are Weeks 3, 4, 6 and 7 because Week 5 is the bye. Week 9 would select the optimistic six-week end, not the midpoint.

sources.title: Jonathon Brooks placed on injured reserve
sources.fact: Official placement on IR after aggravation late in Week 2.

sources.title: Five takeaways from Wednesday, including backup plans, bad news for Brooks, and more
sources.fact: Canales said surgery was planned and recovery was six to eight weeks with or without surgery.

sources.title: Panthers coach Dave Canales says RB Jonathon Brooks expected to miss 6-8 weeks
sources.fact: AP reported surgery planned for Thursday September 24 and return expected later this season.

De'Zhaun Stribling.rationale: Participated in the Week 1 opener before ankle injury even though no offensive box-score statistic appears; Week 1 is not a full injury absence. September 16 surgery and the reported approximately ten-week recovery reach November 25, making Week 12 the calendar-based estimate. IR eligibility in Week 6 is much earlier than expected recovery; exclude Week 8 bye.

sources.title: Injury Update: De’Zhaun Stribling Undergoes Ankle Surgery, Placed on IR with 10-Week Timeline
sources.fact: Shanahan said ankle surgery entails approximately ten weeks; Week 1 injury and late-November return discussed.

sources.title: De’Zhaun Stribling Injury: Officially placed on IR
sources.fact: IR placement Saturday; Week 1 deltoid ankle sprain required surgery, roughly ten-week absence.

Ja'Kobi Lane.rationale: Played Week 1, fractured wrist and underwent successful September 16 surgery. Four required IR games are Weeks 2, 3, 4 and 5. Week 6 is a justified point estimate because Minter explicitly targeted the minimum IR stay; it remains a best-case target rather than guaranteed clearance.

sources.title: Ravens Place Promising Rookie Ja’Kobi Lane on Injured Reserve
sources.fact: Successful wrist surgery Wednesday; Minter explicitly said the minimum IR stay was the target.

sources.title: Ravens place rookie WR Ja’Kobi Lane on injured reserve with wrist injury
sources.fact: First eligible return Week 6 October 18 after four missed games; calls it best-case scenario.

Jordan Mason.rationale: Played Week 1 and underwent thumb repair before September 16 IR placement. The four missed IR games are Weeks 2 through 5. O’Connell specifically expected a short four-week absence; the Week 6 bye pushes the next scheduled game to Week 7, providing extra healing time without adding a missed game.

sources.title: Vikings Place Jordan Mason on Injured Reserve, Sign DeeJay Dallas from Practice Squad
sources.fact: Official IR placement and Week 1 participation confirmed.

sources.title: Vikings RB Jordan Mason heads to IR with fractured thumb
sources.fact: Thumb fracture repaired; O’Connell did not anticipate longer than short-term four-week recovery.

Dylan Sampson.rationale: Appeared on kick returns in Week 1 before left-knee injury, so Week 1 is not missed despite no offensive touches. IR began September 15 and first eligibility is Week 6 after missing Weeks 2 through 5. Reports say significant time but expect a return this season, with no diagnosis or reliable duration. Week 9 is a low-confidence provisional estimate allowing roughly eight weeks after injury and three games beyond eligibility; it is not a reported prognosis.

sources.title: Browns place RB Dylan Sampson on injured reserve (9.15.26)
sources.fact: Official IR placement for knee injury in season opener.

sources.title: Dylan Sampson Injury: Lands on injured reserve
sources.fact: Mary Kay Cabot expected him back this season but exact duration unknown; at least four games required.

AJ Brown.rationale: Played in the September 9 Week 1 opener. IR requires missing Weeks 2 through 5, but eligibility is not expected recovery. September 24 reporting described favorable progress toward the quicker end of six to eight calendar weeks; Week 7 falls just over six weeks after the injury and is the selected return estimate. It remains conditional on functional recovery.

sources.title: NFL Network: Patriots WR A.J. Brown expected to miss six weeks with high ankle sprain
sources.fact: Injured in Week 1 opener and placed on IR; early report expected approximately six weeks.

sources.title: Adam Schefter: A.J. Brown is showing encouraging signs during recovery process
sources.fact: Schefter said Brown moving well and might recover toward six rather than eight weeks; still work left and no confirmed date.

Tank Dell.rationale: Opened the season on IR and misses at least Weeks 1 through 4. Caserio said September 1 he was closer but not ready and that the team would know more after four games. Week 7 is a provisional estimate allowing two weeks of evaluation and practice progression after Week 5 eligibility; Week 5 is not a confirmed return. Avoid the unsupported claim that Dell has done no team drills: official Texans reporting documented team-drill participation August 10.

sources.title: Texans GM Nick Caserio says WR Tank Dell is close to return but what exactly does that mean?
sources.fact: Caserio September 1: closer but not quite ready; more clarity after first four games. Began year on IR.

sources.title: Harris Hits: Tank Dell Returns to Team Drills as Texans Defense Stays Hot
sources.fact: Official team report documented a return to team drills; participation does not establish game readiness.

Jordyn Tyson.rationale: Preseason injury occurred in mid-August, not on the August 30 IR transaction date. The August 17 report expected about two calendar months, reaching mid-October. Week 7 provides an additional week for practice progression after that window. IR first eligibility is Week 5 but is earlier than the expected recovery. Weeks 1 through 3 were missed; no Week 8 bye appears in the absence list.

sources.title: NFL Network: Saints rookie WR Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) expected to miss 2 months
sources.fact: Injury occurred previous week; multiple opinions; expected two-month absence.

sources.title: Jordyn Tyson: Lands on IR, designated to return
sources.fact: Placed on IR with return designation; anticipated absence beyond earliest Week 5 eligibility.

Zach Charbonnet.rationale: Reserve/PUP required at least the first four games missed. September 25 coach update says Week 4 practice return is a possibility, not certainty; Week 6 is a reasonable estimate allowing about two weeks of practice progression. Earlier 2026 rule change permitting Week 3 PUP practice does not shorten four-game ineligibility. Do not infer game clearance from permission to practice.

sources.title: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold Ready To Go; S Julian Love Ruled Out
sources.fact: Macdonald said Charbonnet could return to practice next week; remains on PUP.

sources.title: Macdonald: Seahawks RB Charbonnet nearing return to practice
sources.fact: Must miss first four games on reserve/PUP; 2026 rule permits practice starting Week 3.

Isiah Pacheco.rationale: Started the season on IR. Current September 14 reporting, following completed back surgery, describes roughly twelve weeks of recovery and a chance of early December return. Week 13, December 6, is the selected calendar estimate, not the Week 5 IR eligibility date; exact surgery day was not established, so this remains conditional. Exclude Week 6 bye and do not restart twelve-week clock at the current September 28 snapshot.

sources.title: Isiah Pacheco (back/knee) out for 12 weeks after undergoing back surgery
sources.fact: Embedded Rapoport report: completed surgery relieving pressure on a back nerve; twelve-week recovery with chance of early December return. Article prose says neck in error; the quoted source says back.

sources.title: Lions’ Isiah Pacheco undergoes back surgery, expected to miss significant time
sources.fact: Campbell announced back surgery; season began on IR.

Zay Flowers.rationale: Played Week 1 before hamstring exit, missed Week 2, and returned in Week 3; refreshed box score confirms Week 3 receiving/rushing participation. No future full-game absence projected. A reduced workload is not a missed game.

sources.title: Ravens WR Zay Flowers not expected to play Week 2 vs. Saints
sources.fact: Week 1 aggravation; Week 2 doubtful and expected out.

sources.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) active for Week 3
sources.fact: Officially active after warmups, with possible reduced workload.

Brock Bowers.rationale: Knee cleanup surgery kept him out of Weeks 1 and 2; he returned in Week 3, confirmed by the refreshed receiving box score. No additional full-game absence is projected.

sources.title: Raiders’ Brock Bowers returns to practice, but doubtful for Week 2 vs. Chargers
sources.fact: Missed Week 1 after knee surgery and was doubtful for Week 2.

sources.title: Brock Bowers (knee) active for Week 3
sources.fact: Officially active for season debut against Saints after passing pregame knee testing.

TreVeyon Henderson.rationale: Missed Week 1 with the training-camp ankle injury; returned Week 2 and also played Week 3. Count the lost opener despite his recovery before the Week 3 snapshot. No additional absence estimated.

sources.title: Inactives Analysis: RB TreVeyon Henderson, WR Efton Chism III to make season debuts vs. Steelers
sources.fact: Team confirms Henderson active Week 2 after missing the opener with an ankle injury.
